Packing * — 6. QUALITY & INSPECTION Grade A material only. No mixing of grades within the same order. Any piece found to be below Grade A will be rejected. NexaCrest reserves the right to inspect material at the supplier's premises before dispatch or at the delivery location upon receipt. Material that does not conform to the specifications in Section 3 will be rejected. Supplier must replace rejected material within 7 days at no additional cost to NexaCrest. Balance payment will not be released for rejected material. All pieces within a single order must be from the same quarry batch to ensure colour consistency. Visible dramatic colour difference between pieces in the same order is not acceptable. Balance payment released only after: delivery complete + NexaCrest inspection passed + written acceptance issued by NexaCrest. Delivery alone does not trigger balance payment. 7.
